sources.title: ViToSA: Audio-Based Toxic Spans Detection on Vietnamese Speech Utterances
sources.snippet: We propose a pipeline that combines ASR and toxic spans detection for fine-grained identification of toxic content. Our experiments show that fine-tuning ASR models on ViToSA significantly reduces WER when transcribing toxic speech, while the text-based toxic spans detection (TSD) models outperform existing baselines.
